items.title: Every point of the small etale site of a scheme comes from a geometric point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that points of the small etale site of a scheme, and points of its topos, are exactly those induced by geometric points (statement lines 3609-3626). The proof is a long construction: the categorical properties of a point are recorded (proof lines 3633-3645); a comparison map is built for affine objects by splitting a base change into components and using a section, and its independence of the choices is verified (proof lines 3717-3782); and functoriality together with bijectivity completes the argument (proof lines 3784-3789). The non-formal content is the construction of the comparison map and the verification that it does not depend on the auxiliary choices. The claim is H2: a construction carried out in several stages with every input named.
